newsitem.title: CANADA: WCE canola ends down on commission, hedge sales.
newsitem.headline: WCE canola ends down on commission, hedge sales.

text.p: Winnipeg Commodity Exchange canola futures closed lower on commission house and hedge selling with declines in CBOT soybean futures also cited during the session, traders said.
"Commission houses and locals were selling and there were about 450 hedges," a trader said of trade in canola.
November WCE canola crush profit margin rose to -17.38 Thursday from -23.49 Wednesday. Jan-Mar $1, 100 Sep-Nov $1, Aug-Nov $4. Volume was 2,635 lots.
September canola lost $4.30 to close at $358.90 and November ended down $4.60 at $359.70.
November flax fell $1.40 to $298.30 on local and commercial selling. About 200 Sep-Nov spread from $12 to $10, Nov-Jan $2. Volume 600 lots.
Oats and feed peas did not trade.
October western barley lost $0.50 to settle at $134.50 and December finished $0.10 higher at $136.60 with Alberta Wheat Pool buying late, traders said. Oct-Dec $2. Volume was 1,100 lots.
October feed wheat rose $0.10 to $159.50 and December closed up $0.30 at $159.50 on local and commission selling.
(All values in Canadian dollars per tonne except oats, feed peas.)
